lede: Both from my 2026 term at NASA Glenn. Links go live as each clears review.

items.title: Non-Destructive Prediction of Vacuum Outgassing Total Mass Loss in Multilayer Aerospace Insulation Using Quantitative Color Analysis and Machine Learning
items.note: Extended prior polymer color-analysis machine learning research to complex materials under extreme-heat environments; collaborated with a software engineering intern to implement new models, raising pass/fail prediction accuracy from 83.3% to 93.1% over the prior neural-network approach, and authored a scientific paper for submission to a major journal.

items.title: Regolith as In-Situ Nucleating Agents in Poly(3-Hydroxybutyrate) Composites for In-Space Manufacturing
items.note: Contributed DSC and outgassing characterization to a study of composite systems for lunar habitation structures.
